benefits_life_008.evidence: A group life and accidental death and dismemberment policy providing $20,000 level term insurance with coverage to 65 years of age, retirement or separation from employment, plus $15,000 accidental death benefit will be provided to regularly assigned teachers with the District paying full premium.

benefits_disability_009.evidence: The District shall provide all regularly assigned teachers with a fully paid Income Protection Plan. This program provides benefits after an accident or illness.
